text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: In order to master her usage of "Hadou Tensei", Kyaru was training by dodging {0}'s attacks.
text_block_list.orig_text:
覇瞳天星の力を使いこなすため、
キャルは{0}の攻撃をかわす特訓をしていた。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Come, {0}! I can keep going, you know!
text_block_list.orig_text:
来なさい、
{0}！
まだまだいけるわ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: T-This is nothing! I've decided to face this power in my own way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
これくらい大したことないわ。
あたしはあたしなりに、
この力と向き合うって決めたの！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: So... Mm... there's no point in trying to stop me. Come on, one more round! If you don't come at me, I'll kill you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから……
止めたって無駄よ。
さあ、
もう一回！　
かかってこないとぶっ殺すわよ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Ahh... Damn it, this is way worse than "bad"... I only trained with you for a little while, but my whole body aches. Especially my brain...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー……
やっぱ、
やばいなんてもんじゃないわね～……
あんたとちょっと訓練しただけだってのに、
身体中痛いったらないわ。
特に脳みそが……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: As if. That wasn't even close to enough. But...
text_block_list.orig_text:
んなわけないでしょ。
あれでも足りないくらいよ。
でも──

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Hadou Tensei. I'm copying, arranging and adapting it to be used, yet... it's truly an overwhelming power.
text_block_list.orig_text:
覇瞳天星。
陛下の力を複写して、
アレンジして、
使わせてもらってるけど……
改めて、
とんでもないわ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Calling it "seeing future possibilities" sounds simple enough, but it actually involves calculating an enormous amount of information for those predictions to exist. Her Majesty could wield this ability freely.
text_block_list.orig_text:
未来の可能性を視る、
なんて
言葉で言うのは簡単だけど
とんでもない情報量を演算して、
未来を予測するのよ。
陛下はこの能力を自在に使いこなしてた。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Calculating every parameter across the entire battlefield in parallel and instantly deriving the optimal move... it's a feat that's usually unimaginable.
text_block_list.orig_text:
戦場全体のあらゆるパラメータを並列計算して
最適な一手を瞬時に導き出す……
ふつうは想像もできないような芸当よ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...But. That is exactly why I need to get used to wielding this power, if only a little. I'm borrowing Her Majesty's authority here, so I can't afford to show off something disgraceful.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……でも。
だからこそ、
少しでもこの力に慣れないと。
陛下の権能をお借りしてるんだもの、
みっともない真似はできないわ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's try it out in a real battle against some monsters today! Come on, let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし、
今日は魔物相手に実戦で試してみましょ！
ほら、
行くわよ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Get used to it...? We don't really have the time to afford such a gentle approach. ...Well, it wouldn't be funny if I collapsed from the recoil while fighting a monster. But then, what am I supposed to do?
text_block_list.orig_text:
慣らすって……
そんなぬるいことしてる場合じゃないんだけど。
……
まあ、
魔物と戦ってるとき
反動でブッ倒れたらシャレにならないし。
でもそれなら、
どうするっての？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Hmm. So you want me to start by predicting what people in town will do, huh.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふーん。
まずは街の人の行動を予知してみろ
ってのね。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: All right, let's get this done. That woman with a shopping basket...
text_block_list.orig_text:
んじゃ、
やるわよ。
あの買い物カゴを持った女性……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...She'll buy daikon radish and green onions.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……買うのは大根とネギね。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: See? Look! Bullseye. Heheh, not too shabby.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら見なさい、
ドンピシャ。
ふふん、
なかなかいけるじゃない。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Next. That man... he's pretending to go to the toilet, but... He's planning to ditch work. He's going to take a nap in the alley.
text_block_list.orig_text:
次。
あの男性、
トイレに行くフリして……
サボるつもりね。
路地裏で昼寝する気だわ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: That said, I think I'm starting to get the hang of it. If it's just predicting everyday activities, it's not that much of a burden...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
ちょっとコツが分かってきたかも。
日常の行動くらいなら、
そんなに負担も──

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Ah...! That kid! He's going to trip within three seconds!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──あ。
あの子、
３秒後に転ぶ！

text_block_list.name: 男の子
text_block_list.text: わっ……？
text_block_list.orig_text: わっ……？

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Onii-chan, thank you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おにいちゃん、
ありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Then, thank you too, Onee-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだったの？
じゃあ、
おねえちゃんもありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I-It's not like... I just happened to see it, that's all. I'm glad you weren't hurt.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……べつに、
あたしは視えただけだし。
怪我がなくてよかったわね。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: But, this... it only works because the situation is calm. I wonder how well it will perform under the pressure of combat...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもこれは、
平常時だからうまくいってるだけよ。
戦闘中みたいな緊張状態で
どこまで使えるか……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...Okay. Go along with what I say. I'll anticipate your attacks and dodge them. We're going to do this more seriously than yesterday...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……よし。
付き合いなさい。
あんたの攻撃を
あたしが予知してかわす。
昨日より本格的にやるわよ……！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: No one will bother us here. Pick up some stones laying around here. You'll throw them at me from behind, and I'll make sure to dodge them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここなら邪魔も来ないでしょ。
そのへんの石
拾いなさい。
あんたが後ろから投げて、
あたしがかわす！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...I saw it! To the right!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……視えた！　
右！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Next... a feint to the left followed by an upward shot! I can see right through you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
次……
左のフェイントから上！
そのくらいお見通しよ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Heheh, how's that? If I can predict its trajectory, dodging a stone is a simple matter.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふんっ、
どんなもんよ。
軌道が視えてれば、
かわすのは簡単ね。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...At this rate, I might be able to push it even further! If I analyze your data more deeply, I should be able to see your next move before you even throw it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……この調子でもっといけるかも。
あんたのデータを深く読めば、
投げる前に次の行動だって見抜けるはずよ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Let me see...
text_block_list.orig_text: どれどれ……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...Wait a minute. What's with this amount of data?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ちょっと待って。
なにこのデータ量。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Your experience points are on a completely different level compared to anyone else! Combat experience, adventure records, part-time jobs, number of people you've met... This is simply too crazy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
経験値が他の人間と桁違いなんだけど。
戦闘経験、
冒険の記録、
アルバイト、
出会った人の数……
全部おかしいんだけど！？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Especially the amounts of GIRLS involved! Why are there so many of them?! I mean, I knew that already... I knew, but still!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
特に関わってる女の子！
なんでこんなに多いのよ！？
いや知ってたけど……
知ってたけどさぁ！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Both "here" and "there"... what's more, there's even more coming... Ugh... I-I'm getting dizzy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こっちにも、
あっちにも……
まだまだ出てくる……
うっ……
く、
くらくらする……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
OF COURSE I'M NOT OKAY! AND THIS IS ALL YOUR FAULT! 
My brain's about to burst from this flood of data...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫なわけないでしょ！
完全にあんたのせいよ！
データの洪水で頭がパンクしそうだわ……！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Ah, another nosebleed... Seriously, how pathetic...
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ……
あ、
また鼻血……
まったく、
情けないったら……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: However... if I pull back now, nothing will change. To get even a little closer to Her Majesty's mastery, I have to go this far...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……でも、
ここで引いたら何も変わらない。
少しでも陛下に近づくためには、
このくらいっ……！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Next! Throw another one like you did before!
text_block_list.orig_text:
次！　
もう一回投げなさい！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...! That was close... But I could see it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ！　
危なっ……
でも、
視えた！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Phew... Keep it up...! I should be able to see even further into the future... Wait...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ……
この調子よ……！
もっと先の未来だって視えるはず──
って……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: W-WHY CAN I SEE YOUR NAKED BODY?! I DON'T GET IT!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんであんたの裸が視えるのよ！？
意味分かんないんだけど！？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: N-No, no, no! Calm down, me! I must simply be tired and confused! That must be it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
いやいやいや！　
落ち着けあたし！
疲れて混乱してるだけよ！
そうに決まってる！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Hey, what are you falling over for?! D-DON'T COME OVER HERE--...
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
なに転んでんのよ！？
こっち来んな──

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: UWAAAAAHHHH!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃ
あああっ！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...Pwah! Wha... WHAT ARE YOU DOING!! You tripped and I fell into the river too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
っぷはっ！
な……
何してくれてんのよ！！
あんたが転ぶから
あたしまで川に落ちたじゃない！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Geez, I'm completely soaked! My hair, my clothes, everything... It's the worst!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もうずぶ濡れよ！
髪も服も全部……
最悪！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh* At this rate, I'll catch a cold. I have no choice but to wring out my clothes and hang them to dry...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はぁ。
このままじゃ風邪ひいちゃう。
服、
絞って干すしか……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Wait. You also got wet, didn't you? Which means... you're also stripping...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
待って。
あんたも濡れてるわよね。
ってことは、
あんたも脱ぐ……？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...So that's why I was able to see you naked? I was foreseeing this kind of future?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……だから裸が視えたってこと？
この未来を予知してたってこと？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: UNGHHHHHH...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: JACKPOT MY ASS!! I'M NOT HAPPY ABOUT THIS IN THE SLIGHTEST!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大当たりじゃないわよ！！
こんな予知、
一ミリもうれしくないから！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Ah, geez! LISTEN UP! You're going to change on the rocks over there! DO NOT come over here until you're dry! Got it?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーもう！　
聞きなさい！
あんたは向こうの岩場で着替える！
乾くまでこっちには絶対来るな！　
いいわね！？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: No turning around, either! If you peek, I'll kill you! Got it?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
振り返るのも禁止！
覗いたら殺す！　
分かった！？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, why am I the one making all those arrangements? I was supposed to be training my precognitive abilities, so why did it turn out like this?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……って、
なんであたしがこんな段取りしてんのよ。
予知の力の特訓してたはずなのに、
なんでこうなるのよーっ！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: It seems like Kyaru's special training to master the usage of "Hadou Tensei" still had a long way to go.
text_block_list.orig_text:
覇瞳天星の特訓は、
まだまだ前途多難のようだった。
